steps.en: Install the library; the FFmpeg binary is fetched for you on first use
steps.zh: 装上库，FFmpeg 二进制首次使用时自动下载

steps.en: Open the source and describe the cut and audio change
steps.zh: 打开素材，写下要截哪段、音量怎么调

steps.en: Make a TextClip title and stack it over the clip
steps.zh: 用 TextClip 做标题，叠到片段上

steps.en: Streams source frames from FFmpeg into NumPy arrays, only the seconds the edit needs
steps.zh: 从 FFmpeg 把源帧流进 NumPy 数组，只取剪辑用到的那几秒

steps.en: Renders every output frame by blending the layers at time t, and mixes the audio
steps.zh: 逐帧按时间 t 合成各图层，同时混好音频

steps.en: Pipes the frames into an FFmpeg encoder and writes the file
steps.zh: 把帧经管道送进 FFmpeg 编码，写出文件

value.en: A multi-layer edit lives as readable Python you can loop over hundreds of files — no hand-written filter graphs
value.zh: 多图层剪辑写成可读的 Python，能对几百个文件循环跑，不用手写滤镜图

sources: https://github.com/Zulko/moviepy README @ 211e4b1 (2026-08-17): pip install moviepy; example with VideoFileClip(...).subclipped(10, 20).with_volume_scaled(0.8), TextClip(font="Arial.ttf", text="Hello there!"), CompositeVideoClip([clip, txt_clip]), write_videofile("result.mp4"); 'How MoviePy works' (frames as numpy arrays, encoded back to mp4)

moviepy/video/io/ffmpeg_reader.py (FFMPEG_VideoReader, rawvideo over stdout pipe) and moviepy/video/io/ffmpeg_writer.py (FFMPEG_VideoWriter, rawvideo piped to ffmpeg)
